title: Seoul vs Tokyo: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Seoul and Tokyo based on Reddit discussions, real costs, climate data, K-pop vs anime culture, and traveler preferences.

faqs.answer: Both are exceptional for first-timers. Reddit consensus leans toward Tokyo for its sheer scale and variety — it's like 10 cities in one — and its world-famous food scene. faqs.answer: Yes, significantly. Seoul is one of the best-value major cities in Asia. Budget hotels run $30–50/night vs $70–120+ in Tokyo.
